visual.name: bfusionConstraintSankey
visual.description: Multi-level Sankey flow diagram showing how budget and resources flow through constraints across up to three target levels, with click-to-focus breakdown.

dataRoles.name: source
dataRoles.description: Source node name (e.g., Total Budget, Budget Constraint, Resource Constraint)

dataRoles.name: target
dataRoles.description: Add up to 3 fields for a multi-level breakdown: Source > Target 1 > Target 2 > Target 3

dataRoles.name: flowValue

dataRoles.name: licenseToken
dataRoles.description: Bind to the single-cell BFusionLicense[Key] column in your model
